title: Theorem 3.6 (Besicovitch-Federer): purely unrectifiable σ-finite sets have null projections for a.e. projection
statement: For n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, N := n + ℓ: if Q ⊆ ℝ^N is purely n-unrectifiable (every countably n-rectifiable subset is Hⁿ-null) and Q = ⋃ⱼ Qⱼ with Hⁿ(Qⱼ) < ∞, then ForAlmostAllProjections N n (fun p ↦ Hⁿ(p(Q)) = 0), i.e. for Lebesgue-a.e. v ∈ (ℝ^N)ⁿ with v linearly independent, Hⁿ(p_v(Q)) = 0 where p_v = frameProjection v is the orthogonal projection onto span v.
